name: TSK Electrónica y Electricidad, S.A.
summary: TSK Electrónica y Electricidad, S.A. provides infrastructure solutions for the energy transition, digitalization, and critical raw material handling industry. It operates through two segments: Energy Transition and Digitalisation, and Handling and Mining. The Energy Transition and Digitalisation segment offers design, engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, operation, and maintenance of power plants and energy infrastructure, including industrial plants, substations and transmission lines, data centers, automation and control systems, and cybersecurity.
